name: stayvista
description: StayVista — a desktop-only, independently implemented reconstruction of an Airbnb listing experience (listing page, photo tour, lightbox).

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.verify:geometry: node scripts/verify-geometry/build-css.mjs && node scripts/verify-geometry/build-html.mjs && node scripts/verify-geometry/measure.mjs
scripts.verify:a11y: node scripts/verify-geometry/build-css.mjs && node scripts/verify-geometry/build-html.mjs && node scripts/verify-geometry/audit-a11y.mjs
scripts.verify:tour: node scripts/verify-geometry/build-css.mjs && node scripts/verify-geometry/build-app.mjs && node scripts/verify-geometry/audit-tour.mjs
scripts.verify:harness: npm run verify:geometry && npm run verify:a11y && npm run verify:interactions && npm run verify:tour && npm run verify:lightbox && npm run verify:release && npm run verify:tokens
